newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's AeroPeru says 70 people on crashed plane.
newsitem.headline: Peru's AeroPeru says 70 people on crashed plane.

text.p: Peruvian airline AeroPeru said 61 passengers and nine crew members were on its Boeing 757 which crashed in the Pacific ocean early on Wednesday.
AeroPeru spokeswoman Marcela Velarde could not confirm if there were any survivors of the accident.
The Peruvian fire department had earlier said at least 200 people were on board the plane, and most had died.
"We still have the figure of 215 on board," a fire department spokesman said after AeroPeru gave its information.
At the scene of the crash, rescue workers said it was possible there were some survivors but heavy fog was preventing helicopters and lifeboats from entering the sea.
Rescuers placed lights on the coast to guide survivors in from the sea, and nearby hospitals were readying to receive victims.
